sections.heading: What is Real Estate?
sections.text: Real estate includes land and buildings used for living or investment.

sections.heading: Why Invest
sections.text: Property can generate rental income and long-term value growth.

sections.heading: Buying Property
sections.text: Set budget → choose location → arrange financing → verify documents.

sections.heading: Importance of Location
sections.text: Location determines property value and future growth.

sections.heading: Costs
sections.text:
- Property price
- Loan EMI
- Taxes
- Maintenance

sections.heading: Mortgage
sections.text: A loan used to buy property, repaid over long periods.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.text:
- High investment
- Low liquidity
- Market fluctuations
